submission.justification: Mixture-G2 at 1.5 mm gap delivers the best time resolution of 0.879 ns, significantly outperforming Mixture-G1 (1.315 ns at 2.0 mm) and Mixture-G3 (1.975 ns at 2.0 mm). This represents a 33% improvement over the next-best option, which is substantial for detector performance. The 1.5 mm gap falls within the specified 1-3 mm constraint range. CRITICAL CAVEAT: GWP data was not available during the analysis (gwp_data_available=0), so compliance with the hard environmental constraint (GWP100 ≤ 150) could not be verified. This recommendation assumes Mixture-G2 meets the GWP requirement, but experimental verification of the GWP100 value is essential before implementation.
